flashcard_questions.q: What is the purpose of a mind map?
What is the purpose of a mood board?
flashcard_questions.a: To present the visual concept and intended style of a product.

flashcard_questions.q: Where is the main subject placed on a mind map?
flashcard_questions.a: In the centre of the page.

flashcard_questions.q: What should branches on a mind map be labelled with?
flashcard_questions.a: Short keywords or phrases, not full sentences.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is colour coding used on a mind map?
flashcard_questions.a: It helps distinguish different categories of branch.

flashcard_questions.q: Which element of a mood board shows the colours that will be used?
Which element of a mood board explains why each item was chosen?
What advantage does a physical mood board have over a digital one?
flashcard_questions.a: Real textures and materials can be seen in person.

flashcard_questions.q: What advantage does a digital mood board have over a physical one?
flashcard_questions.a: It is easy to update and share with remote clients.

flashcard_questions.q: When in a project should a mind map be used?
flashcard_questions.a: At the very start, to brainstorm ideas.

flashcard_questions.q: When should a mood board be produced?
flashcard_questions.a: After initial ideas have been generated and a direction is agreed.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the aesthetic of a media product?
flashcard_questions.a: Its overall look and visual style.

notes: 12 cards: 2 document-to-purpose, 4 component/convention cards, 2 physical vs digital, 2 timing cards, 1 term-to-definition, 1 causal. Software names (MindMeister, Canva) dropped as flavour.
